title: Spec amendment (1a/1b): terminal-output-safety requirement in the Status contract — the requirement the six-round terminal-cleaning work was built without; specifies the class by Unicode property, the systematic sink, the mechanism, and the shared-primitive boundary raise

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
AMENDMENT DRAFT — awaiting operator ratification (I draft, you ratify; on your word it binds, I apply the contract text + Revision line, run the minimal rebuild, one verify round, and close Layer 3). Routed here from the Layer-3 terminal-safety finding class (#788/#793/#798/#803/#804 and siblings) per the #806 phase-4 pass.

PROPOSED ADDITION to the Status requirement (contract ~line 173), a new paragraph:

  'Terminal-output safety: every string vsdd renders to a terminal or
   agent-consumed surface — the segment, the human form, the machine
   form, and the broken-state outputs — that is sourced from outside the
   tool's own trusted constants (adopter-edited state, tracker and git
   query output, adopter-authored registry data) is stripped of the
   display-unsafe Unicode class before it reaches that surface. The class
   is defined by Unicode property, never a hand-enumerated list: the
   control category, the format category, the line and paragraph
   separators, and every code point carrying Default_Ignorable_Code_Point
   — including the property's reserved (unassigned) half, which renders
   invisibly on conformant terminals. Combining marks and normal spaces
   are preserved: they are legitimate text in the world's scripts, not
   the hidden-Unicode threat. Cleaning happens at the source boundaries —
   the acquisition, the state read, and the registry load — so every
   downstream rendering inherits safe data; the machine form, whose
   serialization can carry any struct field, is additionally sanitized
   whole at output so no field can be missed. The threat is
   display-spoofing and invisible smuggling into agent context (the
   Trojan-Source class; the same hidden-Unicode threat crosslink names for
   inbound web content), and the requirement is the outbound peer of
   that inbound rule.'

PLUS a Trust-boundaries / boundary-procedure note (raise, do not block):

  'Terminal-output safety is a candidate shared primitive: crosslink's
   safe-fetch already sanitizes inbound content and its rules name the
   hidden-Unicode threat, so a single shared implementation could serve
   both the inbound (strip what you read) and outbound (strip what you
   emit) directions rather than each tool re-deriving it. vsdd satisfies
   the requirement locally now via the UCD property; the shared-primitive
   question is raised to crosslink under the three-question boundary
   procedure (vsdd-cli #739) as a separate, non-blocking item.'

MECHANISM (verification-architecture note, 1b): the implementation uses the Default_Ignorable_Code_Point property from a maintained UCD crate (verify exact crate/API at implementation — unicode-properties is the candidate), REPLACING the hand-rolled category+range+Hangul-enumeration classifier. The enumeration approach is explicitly rejected: rounds 3-6 demonstrated it is always one adversarial probe short of the class. The existing rounds-1-to-5 tests become this requirement's verification architecture; the round-6 uncommitted edits are superseded (keep the recursive JSON sanitizer, discard the Hangul enumeration).

SCOPE: the init/preflight command surface (the Layer 4 carry, #796) falls under this same requirement when Layer 4 hardens; the cleaner is the shared one.

ON RATIFICATION, in order: apply the clause + Revision line (mdatron verify); swap the predicate to the UCD property and keep the machine-form recursive sanitizer (drop the uncommitted Hangul arm); re-point the existing terminal-safety tests as the requirement's verification; one verify round against the specified requirement; close #803/#804/#805 as resolved-by-amendment; close Layer 3 to its boundary. RATIFICATION ASK: approve the two clauses as drafted, or redline.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
COLD REVIEW RETURNED — 5/5 lenses revise-before-ratify (fable-5, 276k tokens, within the 150-320k band; 0 dispatch failures). 43 findings, deduped to 24 distinct. TRIAGE + ROUTING (routing before fixing):

CONVERGENT BLOCKERS (multiple independent lenses):
- D1 [Security+SA, both BLOCKING]: the strip-set and preserve-set OVERLAP. Default_Ignorable_Code_Point includes variation selectors (U+FE00-FE0F, U+E0100-E01EF), the combining grapheme joiner, Mongolian VS — all category Mn. REQ-2 says strip all Default_Ignorable AND preserve Mn/Mc/Me: contradiction, no precedence. AND the draft's 'no behavioral loss' claim is FALSE — text.rs's variation_selectors_survive test pins U+E0100 as KEPT (#798 ruling), which a pure property predicate strips. -> OPERATOR TRIAGE (reverses #798; security-vs-fidelity).
- D2 [SO BLOCKING]: scope. REQ-1's 'agent-consumed surface' generality is silently narrowed to Status's 4 forms, leaving generated agent context (built from the adopter registry — the biggest agent-context pipeline, the named threat's prime target) and gate outputs neither bound nor excluded. -> OPERATOR TRIAGE.
- D3 [SO+Security+SA+DR, 4 lenses]: the dual sink is not gapless. Broken-state human diagnostic composes from a FAILED read (upstream of every source boundary, not the machine form so no whole-output backstop) and can quote raw adopter bytes; shell-joined git-ref strings and the statusline repo-set config load also escape the 3 named boundaries. -> FIX PASS.

OPERATOR-TRIAGE (spec-intent / structure):
- D4 [SO->Trust-boundaries(c); SA->standalone requirement(b); both reject Status-clause(a)]: clause placement. -> OPERATOR TRIAGE.
- D9 [Security]: confusables/homoglyphs (CVE-2021-42694, the OTHER Trojan Source CVE) neither in nor out of scope; no stripping class catches them. -> OPERATOR TRIAGE (propose: out-of-scope accepted residual).

FIX-PASS (self-resolvable, folding into the revised draft):
- D5 [SO+SA]: #739 three-question procedure MISCITED — it governs mdatron check-needs and literally forbids the raise; record as a plain crosslink-tracker proposal, #739 as precedent only.
- D6 [SO+SA+DR]: REQ-6 carries transient content (round-6 uncommitted-edit disposition, clean_json_strings identifier, 'uncommitted') into standing contract text — keep durable mechanism, move edit-disposition to the decision record.
- D7 [SO+Security+DR]: REQ-1 external-source parenthetical reads exhaustive but omits repo-set config, artifact manifest, settings, .vsdd/config.yaml — define as complement-of-trusted-constants, anchor to Trust-boundaries enumeration, mark illustrative.
- D8 [Security]: CRATE — neither unicode-general-category nor unicode-properties carries the property; Default_Ignorable_Code_Point is a DerivedCoreProperties binary property, not General_Category. icu_properties (ICU4X) is the verified-capable candidate; forbid hand-deriving from category data (that IS the rejected enumeration).
- D10 [SA]: the whole-of-output pass is unclassified vs the purity enumeration; classify as a pure filter applied once by the shell at output (not a second derivation).
- D11 [Security]: machine-form backstop exempts JSON keys on an unstated invariant; clean keys too (identity on the trusted case) or state the invariant with a falsifier.
- D12 [TW]: draft has NO verbatim clause text — only REQ-level descriptions; add a 'Proposed contract text' section with the exact insertions + Revision entry so the words shipping are the words reviewed (cures the #808-shaped gap).
- D13 [TW+SO+DR]: AC-8 Revision anchor wrong — anchor on the re-entry issue carrying ratification (not #807), name composition + terminal-verify round, put #807/#808 in motivated-by.
- D14/D15 [Security]: name accepted residuals — combining-mark flooding (bound by cell/grapheme budgets), and blank-but-cell-occupying chars (U+2800, exotic Zs).
- D16-D24 [register, multi-lens]: drop 'three members' count; expand 'UCD'; write out 'SA/SO'; 'three forms + broken-state branch' not 'four surfaces'; drop coined 'systematic sink' (a source is not a sink); 'Trojan Source' unhyphenated; own the ZWJ/ZWNJ strip trade-off; rephrase REQ-7 'the cleaner'; D23 silent-strip accepted-with-reasoning.

NEXT: operator triage on D1/D2/D4/D9, then one fix pass folding all fix-pass items + rulings, verbatim clause text added, then terminal + final verify, then ratification.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR TRIAGE — 4 rulings (2026-07-28): D1 STRIP variation selectors (the Default_Ignorable property wins over combining-mark preservation; the class is Cc|Cf|Zl|Zp|Default_Ignorable_Code_Point, the base char survives, invisible payload channel closed; REVERSES #798, inverts variation_selectors_survive). D2 BIND at owning layer (Status now, generated context + gate outputs + init at their layers). D4 STANDALONE requirement 'Terminal output safety' with a leading name + Trust-boundaries cross-reference for the raise and peer framing. D9 confusables (CVE-2021-42694) OUT OF SCOPE as a DECLARED residual — stripping is the wrong mechanism for visible chars; confusable-skeleton detection routed to the shared-primitive raise; CVE citation split (cite 2021-42574 for the bidi half covered). Fix pass now folds these + all fix-pass findings + a verbatim 'Proposed contract text' section (D12) so the register is reviewed against shipping words.
